proposal.summary: CentOS Web Panel v6 - v7 is vulnerable to SQL injection in admin/loader_ajax.php (ajax=dashboard&action=searchIn&term) allowing error-based and time-based injection to read database contents and induce delays.

C.quote:
AND (SELECT 1197 FROM(SELECT COUNT(*),CONCAT(0x716b6a7171,(SELECT
(ELT(1197=1197,1))),0x71707a7671,FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM
INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PLUGINS GROUP BY x)a)-- aRuO

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the injection against the stated endpoints to confirm authentication requirements and impact (read/write). If confirmed, identify and patch the vulnerable query handling 'term' in loader_ajax.php; if authentication is required, verify session handling and apply parameterized queries and input validation.
